atoms.b:
Eilean Donan Castle

• located in the ((++west_of_Scotland east_of_Dornie)), at ((Loch_Duich --Loch_Ness))
• built in ((++1220 1920))
• ancestral seat of ((++Clan_Macrae the_royal_family))
atoms.sound: Scotland's landscapes are beautiful. Most people think of big Lochs, the Scottish lakes, and old castles at the shore surrounded by grassy mountains when they hear Scotland. The Eilean Donan Castle fits this description. It is situated in the west of Scotland near Dornie, a small village at Loch Duik in the Highlands. The famous castle was built around 1220 and poses the ancestral seat of Clan Macrae.

atoms.b:
Edinburgh

• located on the ((++east_coast west_coast))
• ((++capital town)) of Scotland
• ((++525,000 252,000)) inhabitants
• holds seat of the Scottish ((++parliament prime_minister))
• many ((++historical biblical)) landmarks
atoms.sound: Edinburgh is one of 32 council areas in Scotland and is located on the east coast in the south of the country. Although it is the capital, it is only the second largest city. Around 525,000 inhabitants are living there. Since 1999, the seat of the Scottish parliament is based in Edinburgh. The capital is one of the most beautiful cities in Europe. On a walk through the town you encounter one historical landmark after the other.

atoms.b:
Aberdeenshire
• council area is located in the ((++north-east south-west)) of Scotland
• ((++hilly chilly)) landscape with mountains
• many small villages and beautiful old ((++castles huts))
• famous ((++Dunnottar_Castle Glennfinnan_Viaduct)):
• castle ruins located on rocky headland on ((++50_metre 7_metre)) high cliffs
• incredible view over the ((++North_Sea Baltic_Sea))
• parts of the castle are ((++600-800 300-600)) years old
atoms.sound: The council area of Aberdeenshire is located in the north-east of Scotland. The landscape is characterized by hills and mountains as well as small villages and beautiful old castles. One of the most famous sights in the region is Dunnottar Castle. The castle ruins are located on a rocky headland on 50 metre high cliffs and offer an incredible view over the North Sea. Parts of the castle are estimated to be 600-800 years old.
